name: Physical object motion
summary: Make objects jitter, pile up, scatter with seeded velocity and spin, land with a bounce and leave by physics instead of fading.
qualityBar: Seeded scatter bodies are identical for the same seed and different for another; vx within +-450, vy -420..+280, spin within +-0.6 rad, biased upwards
Jitter peaks at exactly its amplitude and is deterministic; different offsets differ
An exiting piece travels over 150 px, accelerates (under 20 percent of the way at half time), alpha reaches 0 only with k = 1
Landing overshoots 5-15 percent, ends at scale 1 and lands exactly in place
bounce(): starts at y0, first touch at sqrt(2h/g), first hop height equals (e v)^2/2g to 0.5 px, never below the floor, continuous, rests on the floor with vy 0
Resting items keep bobbing within 6 px; exiting items move out, down and turn
Demo 8 s 1080x1920 silent: QC passes, no frozen run over 0.5 s
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size 1080x1920 (56 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, silent; engine QC on the card and on the mp4 passed with 1 warning(s), motion floor 0.009710679216149412). I viewed out/contact.png (12 frames, thumbnails) twice: the first version had the hook touching the window and a bounce chip falling through the cog, both fixed; the final sheet is good (sheet and pile, scatter at 2.17 s, drop, bouncing chips, closer).
